final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---------------- bias generation (from 10uA ref) ----------------
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=1
MB1  vbp   ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=1
MP0  vbp   vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1 m=1
MB2  vbpc  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=1
MPCB vbpc  vbpc  vdd  vdd pfet W=0.8 L=2 m=1
MP1  vbnc  vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1 m=1
MNCB vbnc  vbnc  vss  vss nfet W=1 L=4 m=1
* ---------------- input pair + tail ----------------
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=2
M1   na    vinn  tail vss nfet W=6 L=0.5 m=1
M2   nb    vinp  tail vss nfet W=6 L=0.5 m=1
* ---------------- folded cascode ----------------
MP3  na    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1 m=2
MP4  nb    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1 m=2
MP5  fl    vbpc  na   vdd pfet W=10 L=0.5 m=1
MP6  o1    vbpc  nb   vdd pfet W=10 L=0.5 m=1
MN7  fl    vbnc  nl   vss nfet W=3 L=0.5 m=1
MN8  o1    vbnc  nr   vss nfet W=3 L=0.5 m=1
MN5  nl    fl    vss  vss nfet W=3 L=1 m=1
MN6  nr    fl    vss  vss nfet W=3 L=1 m=1
* ---------------- second stage (CS) ----------------
M7   vout  o1    vss  vss nfet W=20 L=1 m=1
M8   vout  vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1 m=10
* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
Rz   o1    nc    2000
Cc   nc    vout  1.5e-12
.ends dut
